correctness.rationale: A projective singular point has all coordinates nonzero. With their squares A,B,C and u=−2t, the gradient equations are A²=uBC, B²=uAC, C²=uAB. They imply u³=1, and (1,u⁻¹,1) gives a solution of the square equations if u³=1; Euler's identity puts its lift on the curve. Thus t³=3 is precisely the excluded locus. Bézout excludes a smooth reducible plane sextic; the genus is ten. The Frobenius formula follows by multiplying the fifth powers of the Čech fractions by F_t⁴. An independent exact multinomial calculation recovered all ten potentially nonzero entries and the other ninety zeros: enumerate nonnegative i,j,k,l summing to 4, match (6i+2l,6j+2l,6k+2l) against each Čech target exponent triple, and add 4!/(i!j!k!l!)·t^l modulo 5. The two possible source/target transpose conventions give the same symmetric matrix. The three t² lines and three 2t swaps stay bijective under every semilinear iteration if t≠0. The remaining line has coefficient t⁴−t, and all entries vanish at zero, giving the three stable ranks and the corresponding one-step coranks. The separable coordinate-square map onto the smooth Hesse cubic has generic fiber the four projective sign choices; sign changes fix just the central cohomology line as a common invariant. Its coefficient is also the cubic Hasse coefficient. The norm composed with pullback is [4], so the complementary cohomology is that of the nine-dimensional isogeny factor, ordinary at every nonzero smooth parameter. Superspeciality at zero follows from a-number equal to dimension.
residual_risks: The uploaded verifier was inspected, not executed. Its finite F₂₅ checks are not needed for the geometric smoothness and stable-rank arguments. No claim of classifying all automorphisms or the full p-divisible group is made.

value.rationale: For a known symmetric sextic, the elliptic quotient gives a natural source of nonordinarity but leaves most of the genus-ten Jacobian undetermined. Proving its complementary factor is ordinary at every nonzero smooth parameter explains why exactly three smooth nonzero coefficients produce a rank drop, why that drop is exactly one, and how those fibers differ from the superspecial Fermat degeneration. This complete exceptional-locus calculation over the algebraic closure, not just a small-field table or a restatement of the elliptic criterion, is useful for comparing arithmetic of the pencil and its quotient.
residual_risks: Value is assessed for this marked family and fixed characteristic; no general rule for all covers or primes is inferred.
